chain.title: Turn rotation into shaped metal
chain.desc: Connect a Rolling Mill to Create rotational power. Use the installed rolling recipes for wires and rods; keep its output clear before feeding a continuous batch.

chain.title: A reusable wire component
chain.desc: Craft empty spools for wound wire. This component is useful alongside the rolling setup and does not require an existing electrical grid.

chain.title: Roll wire for the first circuit
chain.desc: Run the installed copper input through the Rolling Mill. Reserve wire for spools and connectors before expanding into larger energy devices.

chain.title: Wind the machine coils
chain.desc: Combine wire with a spool. Copper spools are shared components for the alternator and electric motor, which perform opposite energy conversions.

chain.title: Press zinc into a component
chain.desc: Use a Create press and the installed zinc-sheet recipe. Sheets support electrical components while the rolling mill handles the wire branch.

chain.title: A component for conversion machines
chain.desc: Craft a Capacitor from the installed plate recipe. Prepare it alongside spools before setting up the Mechanical Crafters for larger machines.

chain.title: Convert rotation into Forge Energy
chain.desc: Assemble the Alternator using Create's Mechanical Crafters. Feed it rotational power and connect an energy consumer; account for the stress load on the mechanical network.

chain.title: Convert Forge Energy into rotation
chain.desc: Assemble the Electric Motor with the required brass parts and Mechanical Crafters. Supply energy and set a suitable speed. A motor feeding an alternator is not a source of free energy.

chain.title: Give the electrical route endpoints
chain.desc: Place connectors and link them with the appropriate wire spool. Check their supported transfer rate and connection distance before spanning the factory.

chain.title: Switch a circuit deliberately
chain.desc: Add a Redstone Relay where the electrical route needs on/off control. Test the switching behavior on one machine before applying it to the main power feed.

chain.title: Buffer the mechanical-electric boundary
chain.desc: Build and connect a Modular Accumulator setup using the documented arrangement. Use it to buffer energy between machines with different demand cycles.

chain.title: A powered charging station
chain.desc: Supply the Tesla Coil with energy and use the supported charging or processing behavior. Keep its operating area intentional and check the recipe viewer for compatible transformations.

chain.title: Power a moving contraption at a stop
chain.desc: Mount a Portable Energy Interface on the contraption and align it with a stationary partner. Test transfer while the contraption is correctly positioned before relying on it in a larger route.

chain.title: An optional perimeter material
chain.desc: Make Barbed Wire from the installed rolling components. Place it deliberately around a controlled boundary; this building branch does not gate the power machines.

chain.title: Prepare a tougher abrasive
chain.desc: Produce Diamond Grit with the supported crushing recipe. Use it where the addon accepts a stronger abrasive rather than spending diamonds on unrelated electrical parts.

chain.title: A durable polishing tool
chain.desc: Craft Diamond Grit Sandpaper and use it with supported polishing recipes. This utility upgrade is independent of the generator and motor routes.

chain.title: A conditional alloy route
chain.desc: If the pack supplies silver, mix gold and silver with the required heat to make electrum, or use another installed alloy recipe. Create Crafts and Additions alone does not provide the silver source.

chain.title: Press the alloy into sheets
chain.desc: Use the installed Create pressing recipe to shape electrum. Keep this optional alloy branch separate from the basic copper power route.

chain.title: An optional personal accessory
chain.desc: Craft the Electrum Amulet using the installed recipe and inspect its equipment requirements. This branch depends on an obtainable electrum supply in the pack.

chain.title: Turn organic inputs into fuel material
chain.desc: Use an accepted mixing recipe to create Biomass from organic ingredients. Follow the processing chain shown by the recipe viewer before treating it as finished fuel.

chain.title: Prepare a usable biomass fuel
chain.desc: Process Biomass into pellets using the installed recipe. Compare accepted fuel uses and automate a renewable ingredient supply if this becomes part of your factory's energy plan.

notes: Re-reviewed 2026-10-07 against local Minecraft 1.20.1 JAR item assets and selected recipes/manuals, with official project sources listed separately. Every authored row now has explicit prerequisites; empty lists identify intentional branch roots. The coverage section states the verified versions and remaining limits. This replaces older list-order and item-count claims.

coverage.scope: Authored branched progression; item and component acquisition objectives, not automatic proof that a factory works.
milestones: Conditional electrum and biomass utility branches
limits: Item IDs checked against cached jars and installed 1.2.5/1.3.3 Minecraft 1.20.1 jars.
Requires Create; electrum additionally needs a silver source or pack-added recipe.
Basic materials tasks do not force unrelated utility and alloy branches onto the power path.
Pack scripts, recipe changes, and other Minecraft versions require the installed-pack scan; this guide is not a complete mod manual.
coverage.verification: Local JAR item models and English registry names; selected recipes and bundled manuals checked. Not a new in-game playthrough.
